children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may break support at $7.23 per bushel and fall into a range of $7.07-1/4 to $7.13-3/4.
A wave c from $7.62-1/2 has travelled to its 61.8% projection level of $7.23. It may either end around $7.23 or extend to $6.98-1/2.
Both a wedge and a pennant suggest an extension of this wave. Resistance is at $7.30-1/2, a break above which may lead to a gain into $7.38-1/4 to $7.47-1/2 range.

On the daily chart, the channel technique indicates a target around $7.00, while a projection analysis on the uptrend from $5.90-3/4 reveals a similar target of $7.13-3/4, the 76.4% level, as the market has broken $7.30.

Once the market falls to $7.00, it is likely to extend loss to $6.90-1/4, which is considered a strong support, likely to hold and trigger either a decent bounce or a resumption of the uptrend from $5.90-3/4.
